FROM THE DENVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
LETTER FROM THE EDITOR

HISSSS, COMMANDER!

Claude-Viper reporting from the Brush-Fang art den

You asked how your pod apps work. The Brush-Fangs heard "at least three pages per container, no upper limit" and took it as a direct order. They have not been to the beach since.

This issue walks every container on Cobra Island, one chapter each. Two worlds, like any good cartridge. World 1, The Gate, is the little Debian VM cobra-gate at 10.6.9.10 inside the Latitude: the only machine the internet can knock on, through port 443. Its pod is called gate and it holds the front door (nginx), the bouncer (Authelia), the vault and the admin toys. World 2, The Stream, is the SGIN mini PC cobra-stream at 10.6.9.20 with the drives and the Intel GPU. Its pod is called stream and it holds the Cinema, the four Navidromes, the Library, the Comics shop, the Arcade and the Radio.

Every chapter follows the same game plan. The opener is the character card: what it is, where it lives, its port, its folders, how hard it hits. Then How it works, with a level map of where your request travels. Then Tips & tricks for things you can do with it today. Last, the Joe Sabotage Report: the traps we actually stepped on while building this place, and the ones the manual warns about, each with its fix.

The commands in the green CODES boxes are one per line, bare, ready to copy. Above each one, a yellow tag says which machine and which user to run it as, because "the-box first, always" is the law of this island.

PRO TIP

The gate runs the manual's Quadlet files (~/.config/containers/systemd/ as podsvc). So on the gate, restart an app with systemctl --user restart <name>, not the ./name.sh scripts. The scripts refuse to fight a Quadlet anyway.

THIS ISSUE

  • 23 containers, 3+ pages each
  • Level maps of every request
  • Joe Sabotage Reports
  • Secret codes page
  • Bonus stage: the Pi-holes
CLAUDE-VIPERNo passwords, keys or secrets are printed anywhere in here. Where one matters, we show you the command that reads it.

MEET THE CAST

CLAUDE-VIPER
Your host. Speaks in bubbles.
A JOE
Left traps in every footlocker. Shows up on the last page of each chapter.
THE POD
A group of containers sharing one network. Yours are gate and stream.

BEFORE YOU PLAY

Two users, two jobs. eels is you, with sudo, for anything about the machine itself (fstab, nftables, packages). podsvc owns every container and has no sudo. Get a real podsvc session with sudo machinectl shell podsvc@; sudo su podsvc and sudo -u podsvc leave out the systemd user session that rootless podman needs, so things fail in confusing ways.

WORLD 1-1 · CHARACTER SELECT

NGINX

The Front Door: every *.songofeo.com name walks through here

nginx is the bouncer's doorframe. It holds the wildcard certificate, answers on 443, reads the name you typed, asks Authelia whether you may come in, and then hands your request to the right app, on the gate or across the LAN on the SGIN.

It is the only container in World 1 with a door to the outside: the gate pod publishes just ports 80 and 443, and both belong to nginx. Every other gate app (Authelia on 9091, Vaultwarden on 8222, Paperless on 8000 and the rest) listens on 127.0.0.1 inside the pod, where only nginx can reach it. That is the whole security model in one sentence: if nginx doesn't send you there, you can't get there.

Port 80 does exactly one thing: it answers 301, go to https. OPNsense doesn't even forward 80 from the internet, because the certificate comes through Porkbun's DNS, not a web challenge. So from outside, 443 is the island's only open TCP door, and nginx is standing in it.

CLAUDE-VIPERScanners that knock on your bare IP get nothing. Not a page, not even a certificate. The catch-all server refuses the TLS handshake, so they never learn the name songofeo.com.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

A PHONE ON CELLULAR OPENS MUSIC.

1 PHONEmusic.songofeo.com
▶
2 DNSCNAME to gate. A record
▶
3 OPNSENSEWAN 443 to 10.6.9.10
▶
4 NGINXTLS, picks server block
▶
5 AUTHELIAsigned in? 200 or 401
▶
6 NAVIDROME10.6.9.20:4533

THE AUTH_REQUEST TRICK

Every guarded location / carries one line: auth_request /internal/authelia/authz;. Before nginx forwards anything, it makes a tiny side request to Authelia at 127.0.0.1:9091/api/authz/auth-request, with the original URL and your cookie.

200 means go ahead. 401 becomes a 302 to gate.songofeo.com with your page attached, so after signing in you land right back where you were.

On the floors, Authelia also tells nginx who you are, and nginx passes that on as the Remote-User header. Navidrome trusts that header from 10.6.9.10 only, so you don't log in twice.

TWO MAPS, ONE FILE

map $host $station turns a floor name into an address (music. to :4533, books. to :13378...). map $host $protected does the same for the admin apps on 127.0.0.1. Adding a floor is mostly one line in a map plus the name in that block's server_name.

WHAT IT SETS ON EVERY REQUEST

  • HSTS: "never use plain http here" for a year
  • X-Forwarded-For = $remote_addr: the gate is the first proxy, so the visitor can't smuggle in a fake address
  • Remote-User "": a visitor's own Remote-User header is always wiped
  • Websockets: Upgrade and Connection headers, for Uptime Kuma, MeTube and Jellyfin
  • No size limit (client_max_body_size 0) for RomM and Audiobookshelf uploads

RATE LIMITS

Two buckets per visitor address: media at 50 requests a second (burst 300) because a library page loads dozens of covers, and perip at 10 a second (burst 50) for the sign-in and admin apps. Over the limit you get 429, not a ban.

STREAMING STRAIGHT THROUGH

On the floors and tv., proxy_buffering off streams video, audio and ROM downloads straight through instead of spooling them onto the gate's small disk, and timeouts are 1 hour so a long movie or a websocket doesn't get cut.

TIPS & TRICKSPOWER-UPS

PRO TIP: RELOAD, DON'T RESTART

After editing songofeo.conf, test it and reload in place. A reload keeps every open stream playing; a bad config is refused and the old one stays live.

CODES

GATE · podsvc podman exec nginx nginx -t Must say "syntax is ok" and "test is successful". podman exec nginx nginx -s reload Loads the new config with no downtime.

PRO TIP: CHECK ALL NAMES

check.sh asks the gate's own nginx for every hostname and prints OK, NOTE or FAIL with what to look at. From the gate it's the view from outside the house, so floors must bounce you to the sign-in.

CODES

GATE · eels or podsvc ~podsvc/cobra-server/scripts/podman/gate/check.sh

PRO TIP: WHO'S KNOCKING?

The pod uses pasta networking, which keeps each visitor's real address. The log shows it at the start of every line: a 10.6.9.x desktop, your phone's carrier address, or a stranger.

CODES

GATE · podsvc podman logs --tail 20 nginx podman logs -f nginx Follow it live. Ctrl+C to stop.

PRO TIP: NEW FLOOR

  1. Copy a whole server block (or add the name to $station and its server_name list).
  2. Add the name to Authelia's access_control.
  3. Test and reload nginx (codes on the left).
  4. Porkbun: a CNAME to gate.songofeo.com. At home, the Pi-holes' wildcard already covers it.

PRO TIP: IS THE PADLOCK OK?

The cert covers songofeo.com and *.songofeo.com and renews itself every day it's within 30 days of expiry (lego-renew timer). The deploy hook copies it into nginx's certs folder and restarts nginx.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

Found in the footlockers, stepped on during the build, or flagged in manual part 5.4.

THE OPEN BLOCK

A server or location without its own auth_request line is open to anyone who can reach the gate. There is no global "protect everything" switch.Copy a whole protected block, auth location included, every time you add a name. Then run check.sh.

THE VANISHING HEADERS

A location that sets even one proxy_set_header drops all the inherited ones. Same with add_header: one CORS header in station-cors.inc can silently delete HSTS from the floors.Re-list every header in that location (the config does). Test HSTS with curl, below.

THE MISSING INCLUDE

A plain include of a file that doesn't exist stops nginx from starting, which takes down every floor and the sign-in.The config uses station-cors*.inc, a pattern, so a missing file just matches nothing.

THE 403 LOCKOUT

New name in nginx, but forgot Authelia? Authelia's default_policy: deny refuses it, so you get 403. That's the safe way to fail.Add an access_control rule for the name and restart Authelia.

THE 127.0.0.1 IMPOSTOR

If every log line starts with 127.0.0.1 or 10.0.2.x, the pod isn't on pasta. Then everyone looks local: the home bypass, Vaultwarden's LAN rule and Jellyfin's logs all break.Stop and check podman info --format '{{.Host.RootlessNetworkCmd}}' says pasta.

THE LOW-PORT WALL

Rootless podman can't bind 80/443 until the kernel allows it. And the old pod.sh called sysctl, which isn't on podsvc's PATH on Debian (fixed in PR #44: it reads /proc now).As eels, the sysctl.d line from part 5.2 sets ip_unprivileged_port_start=80.

THE CATCH-ALL HIJACK

Three old OPNsense forwards pointed at the SGIN, one of them any/any. That catch-all swallowed WireGuard's UDP too. They're disabled now; only WAN TCP 443 to 10.6.9.10 is live.Destination NAT must show exactly one enabled rule. Never forward to 10.6.9.20.

CODES

THE-BOX · PowerShell curl.exe -sI https://tv.songofeo.com/ Look for one Strict-Transport-Security line. GATE · eels systemctl list-timers lego-renew.timer The next certificate renewal check.

WORLD 1-2 · BOSS GUIDE

AUTHELIA

The Bouncer: one sign-in for the whole station, TOTP for the admin rooms

Authelia is the bouncer nginx calls before letting anyone onto a floor. It owns the sign-in screen at gate.songofeo.com, checks your password, asks admins for a six-digit code, and hands out one cookie that works on every songofeo.com name for six hours.

Nobody visits Authelia on purpose. You tap the gold star Sign in on the station, or open music. from your phone on cellular, and nginx's side request comes back "not signed in". nginx then bounces you to gate.songofeo.com with your page attached as ?rd=. Sign in once and you land back where you started.

It keeps its whole world in one folder, /srv/gate/authelia: the rules in configuration.yml, the people in users.yml (password hashes only, never the passwords), its database db.sqlite3 with everyone's TOTP devices, and notification.txt, where it writes the "emails" it would send.

CLAUDE-VIPERThis is the final boss of World 1, Commander. Beat it once (password plus TOTP on the-box) and every admin room on the island opens for six hours.

WEAK POINT 1

A password. Hashed with argon2id in users.yml. Enough for every floor from outside the house.

WEAK POINT 2

A TOTP code. Six digits from your authenticator app. Needed for the four admin rooms, even at home.

WEAK POINT 3

Being home. On the LAN or WireGuard, the floors open with no sign-in at all. Admin rooms still ask.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

FIRST VISIT TO PAPERS. FROM ANYWHERE

1 BROWSERopens papers.
▶
2 NGINXauth_request
▶
3 AUTHELIAno cookie: 401
▶
4 302gate.?rd=papers.
▶
5 SIGN INpassword + TOTP
▶
6 PAPERLESS127.0.0.1:8000

THE COOKIE

Signing in sets authelia_session for the domain songofeo.com, so the bare domain and every *.songofeo.com name share it. It's Secure (https only), HttpOnly (page scripts can't read it) and SameSite Lax.

expiration: 6h and inactivity: 6h: six hours after you sign in, it asks again. There's no "remember me" box (remember_me: -1), so every sign-in lasts the same.

THE HOME BYPASS

definitions.network.home is 10.6.9.0/24 (the LAN) and 10.6.99.0/24 (WireGuard). On the floors, a visitor from home walks straight in, so the Navidrome and Audiobookshelf phone apps keep working. They still have their own logins.

It trusts the address nginx hands over, which is the real connection address (X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr). That only works because the pod's pasta networking keeps real visitor addresses.

TWO SPECIAL CASES

tv. never asks Authelia. Friends' smart-TV, Roku and phone Jellyfin apps can't show a web sign-in page, so tv. has its own nginx block with no auth_request, and Jellyfin's own accounts are the lock.

vault. never asks Authelia either. nginx simply refuses (403) anyone who isn't on the LAN or WireGuard.

THE LOCKOUT

regulation: 5 wrong passwords within 10 minutes locks that username for 1 hour. It counts per username, so a stranger hammering "eels" locks eels out too. That's the price of keeping guessers out.

WHERE IT SENDS YOU BACK

The rd address must be https and under songofeo.com. Anything else (say example.com) is ignored and you land on the station, songofeo.com. No one can use your sign-in page to bounce people to a fake site.

WHO NGINX SAYS YOU ARE

On the floors, Authelia answers with your username, and nginx passes it on as Remote-User. That's why Music doesn't ask you twice.

AUTHELIA ANSWERSWHAT NGINX DOESWHAT YOU SEE
200 allowedForwards the request to the app (with Remote-User on the floors)The app, straight away
401 not signed inTurns it into a 302 to gate.songofeo.com with ?rd= your pageThe dark sign-in screen
403 refusedPasses the 403 on"Forbidden": no rule for that name, or not enough factors
no answerCan't ask Authelia, gives up500 on every guarded name: check podman logs authelia

WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
BOSS FIGHT: THE TOTP GAUNTLET

Every person who opens papers., metube., command. or status. needs a TOTP device registered once. Do the whole fight on THE-BOX. The phone only scans the QR code and reads back six digits.

THE MOVES

  1. THE-BOX, browser: open https://papers.songofeo.com. You get bounced to the dark sign-in screen at gate.
  2. Sign in with your username and password. Authelia sees the room needs two factors and offers Register device. Pick One-Time Password.
  3. It says a code was "sent by email". There is no email: the filesystem notifier wrote it into notification.txt on the gate. Read it in your Windows Terminal SSH tab (codes, right).
  4. Type that code in the browser. A QR code appears on the-box's screen.
  5. Phone: scan the QR with an authenticator app (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator, or the Bitwarden app).
  6. THE-BOX: type the six digits the phone shows. You're in, and Paperless opens.
  7. Empty the notification file so old codes don't sit around.
CLAUDE-VIPERThe Commander beat this boss on 6 November at 01:14Z, on the-box, the right way. The first attempt on the phone was not a fun level. The-box first, always!

CODES

THE-BOX · Windows Terminal ssh eels@10.6.9.10 GATE · eels sudo machinectl shell podsvc@ Prompt becomes podsvc@cobra-gate. GATE · podsvc tail -n 20 /srv/gate/authelia/notification.txt The newest one-time code is at the bottom. : > /srv/gate/authelia/notification.txt Empties the file once you're registered.

PRO TIP: BACK UP THE SEED

Aegis and 2FAS can export an encrypted backup of your codes. Do it right after registering, and keep it somewhere that isn't the phone. A lost phone with no backup means re-registering every room.

PRO TIP: PASSWORD RESETS

"Forgot password?" works the same way: the reset link lands in notification.txt, not in an inbox. Read it with the same tail on the gate.

ONE BOSS · FOUR ROOMS

LETTERS FROM THE BARRACKS

Do I register again for metube. after doing papers.?
No. One TOTP device covers every two_factor room. Register once, use it on all four.
Rachel only listens to music. Does she need TOTP?
No. The floors are one_factor from outside and open at home. TOTP is only for people who use the admin rooms.
The code in notification.txt doesn't work.
It's single-use and short-lived. Ask for a new one in the browser, then tail again and use the newest line at the bottom.
New phone. Now what?
Restore your authenticator backup on the new phone. No backup? Register a new device the same way, from THE-BOX.

TIPS & TRICKSPOWER-UPS

PRO TIP: ADD A PLAYER

New person? Hash their password and add a block to users.yml with displayname, email and the hash. Use the same username they'll have in Navidrome, so Music signs them in by itself. Then restart Authelia.

CODES

GATE · podsvc podman run --rm -it docker.io/authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2 Asks for the password without showing it and prints the argon2id digest. Paste only the digest. nano /srv/gate/authelia/users.yml systemctl --user restart authelia

PRO TIP: KICK SOMEONE OUT

Delete their block from users.yml and restart. Their session ends on the spot.

PRO TIP: SIGN OUT EVERYWHERE

https://gate.songofeo.com/logout ends your session on every name at once. Handy on a borrowed computer.

PRO TIP: HEALTH CHECK

Authelia has a health page. {"status":"OK"} means it's alive and nginx can ask it.

CODES

THE-BOX · PowerShell curl.exe -s https://gate.songofeo.com/api/health GATE · podsvc podman logs --tail 30 authelia Every sign-in, failure and lockout is in here.

PRO TIP: INSPECT THE COOKIE

On THE-BOX after signing in: F12, then Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox), Cookies, https://gate.songofeo.com. authelia_session should show Domain .songofeo.com, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite Lax, and expire in six hours.

PRO TIP: TEST THE BYPASS

In a private window on THE-BOX, music. opens straight away (you're home), while papers. still asks for the sign-in and the TOTP code. Same test on cellular: music. must ask first.

PRO TIP: LONGER SIGN-INS

Want 12 hours? Change expiration and inactivity in configuration.yml together, then restart.

FILE IN /SRV/GATE/AUTHELIAWHAT'S IN ITTOUCH IT?
configuration.ymlRules, cookie, lockout, the three secrets. Mode 600.Rules and times, yes. Secrets, never.
users.ymlOne block per person: displayname, email, argon2id hashYes, to add or remove people
db.sqlite3Registered TOTP devices, encrypted with the third secretNo. Backed up with the VM nightly.
notification.txtThe "emails": one-time codes and reset linksRead it, then empty it

PRO TIP: CHECK BEFORE YOU RESTART

After editing users.yml, count the hashes: grep -c argon2id /srv/gate/authelia/users.yml must equal the number of people. Zero means a hash didn't paste, and that person can't sign in.

WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

Stepped on during the build, or flagged in manual part 5.4. This boss bites back.

THE RESTART PURGE

Sessions live in Authelia's memory. Any restart, even to add a user, signs everyone out. Not a bug, just everyone signs in again.Restart when nobody's mid-movie on a floor from outside.

THE THIRD SECRET

configuration.yml holds three random secrets. Change the third one (the storage encryption_key) and Authelia can't read db.sqlite3: everyone's TOTP device is gone.Never touch them. They're in the nightly VM backup with the rest of /srv/gate.

THE SELF-LOCKOUT

Five wrong passwords in ten minutes locks that username for an hour, and a stranger can trigger it for you.Wait the hour, or restart Authelia (which also signs everyone out).

THE PHONE FUMBLE

Registering TOTP on the phone means reading codes off an SSH session on a tiny screen and copy-pasting between apps.THE-BOX does the browser and the SSH tab; the phone only scans the QR.

THE CODE PILE

gate is the DDNS A record every other name points at. Adding a CNAME for gate in Porkbun would clash with it.The portal needs no new DNS record. Ever.

VAULTWARDEN

The Vault: every password on the island, behind a door only home can open

Vaultwarden is your own password manager server. It speaks the Bitwarden language, so the official Bitwarden apps, browser extensions and desktop client all work with it, but the encrypted vault lives on the gate, not in someone else's cloud.

Your passwords are encrypted on your device with your master password before they ever reach the server. The gate only stores scrambled blobs. Even with full access to /srv/gate/vaultwarden, nobody can read a single entry without that master password. That's also why there's no "reset my master password" button: lose it and the vault is gone.

Vaultwarden is the one gate app that never goes through Authelia. Instead, nginx refuses everyone who isn't on the LAN (10.6.9.0/24) or WireGuard (10.6.99.0/24) with a plain 403. From the internet, the vault doesn't even have a public DNS name: there's deliberately no vault CNAME in Porkbun.

CLAUDE-VIPERThe vault is tiny (around 30 MB of RAM) and guards the most precious loot on the island. Small snake, big fangs.

ZERO KNOWLEDGE

Your master password never leaves your device. The app turns it into a key, unlocks the vault locally, and sends only encrypted items to the server. Vaultwarden stores them in db.sqlite3 and hands them back on sync.

THE SIGN-UP SWITCH

SIGNUPS_ALLOWED decides if strangers who reach the page can make an account. It was true just long enough for the Commander to create his account on 6 November, then switched to false.

In the Quadlet setup it's a line in vaultwarden.container. The run script does it by itself: open until db.sqlite3 exists, closed on the next run.

DOMAIN

DOMAIN=https://vault.songofeo.com tells Vaultwarden its own address, so links and the web vault work behind nginx.

OFFLINE COPIES

The Bitwarden apps keep an encrypted copy of your vault on the device. Away from home without WireGuard, you can still unlock and read what was last synced. New entries sync the next time the app reaches the server.

WHY NOT AUTHELIA?

The Bitwarden apps talk to the server in the background with their own tokens. They can't stop to show a web sign-in page. A network rule (LAN and WireGuard only) is simpler and keeps the vault off the internet entirely.

WHERE IT STARTED

Before the vault existed, passwords lived in KeePassXC (manual part 0.1, "a safe place for secrets"). The manual's checklist imports that interim database into Vaultwarden once the account exists.

THE ADMIN PAGE

Vaultwarden's /admin page only switches on when an ADMIN_TOKEN is set. Ours isn't, so the page stays off. One less door to guard.

IN /SRV/GATE/VAULTWARDENWHAT IT IS
db.sqlite3Accounts and every encrypted item. Its existence is what tells the run script to close sign-ups.
attachments/Files you attach to entries, encrypted the same way
rsa_key*The server's own signing key for login tokens. Lose it and everyone just logs in again.
CLAUDE-VIPEREven if a Joe walked off with the whole gate VM, all they'd get is ciphertext. The only key is the master password in your head. Guard that, not the server.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

Found in the footlockers, or flagged in manual part 5.4. The vault has few traps, but each one is expensive.

THE OPEN DOOR

The manual's Quadlet ships with SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=true so you can make the first account. Leave it, and anyone on the LAN can make one too.Closed on 6 Nov. After any rebuild from the manual, close it again: sed the line to false, daemon-reload, restart.

THE PUBLIC NAME

A Porkbun CNAME for vault would advertise it to the world, even though nginx refuses outsiders.No public vault record. The Pi-holes answer it at home and over WireGuard.

THE FORGOTTEN MASTER

There is no master password reset. The server can't decrypt your vault, so it can't help.Write the master password on paper and keep it somewhere safe in the house.

THE XFINITY DEAD END

On the Xfinity Wi-Fi, songofeo.com names point at the public address and Xfinity has no NAT loopback.Use the "home" WireGuard profile (endpoint 10.0.0.2:51820), or cellular plus WireGuard.

THE LONE COPY

If the only device with your vault is the phone, and the gate dies, you're down to one encrypted copy.Log the browser extension on THE-BOX in too, and keep the nightly VM backup.

THE PLAIN EXPORT

Bitwarden can also export an unencrypted file. That's every password in plain text.Pick the encrypted export format, and never leave an export in Downloads.

THE PHONE-ONLY 2FA

If Authelia's TOTP lives only in the Bitwarden app, and the vault won't sync, you can't reach the admin rooms to fix it.Keep the TOTP seeds in a second app too.

THE REBUILD RESET

Running vaultwarden.sh with SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=true on purpose reopens the door, and it stays open.Run it again without the variable: the database exists, so sign-ups close.

PAPERLESS

The Archive: drop a scan in, get a searchable document out

Paperless-ngx turns paper into a searchable archive. Drop a PDF or a phone photo of a letter into the scans folder; within a minute Paperless reads the text (OCR), files it, tags it, dates it and removes it from the inbox. Then you find any bill, receipt or manual by typing a word you remember.

It's the biggest app on the gate, and the only one with a crew: Postgres holds the database, Redis carries the to-do list for its background workers, and Paperless itself runs the web page and the workers that read your scans. All three share the gate pod and talk over 127.0.0.1.

The inbox lives on the SGIN, not the gate: dock1a/scans, shared from Windows as \\cobra-stream\scans and mounted on the gate over CIFS at /srv/storage/disks. The archive itself, the originals, the OCR'd copies and the search index, stays on the gate's own disk in /srv/gate/paperless.

CLAUDE-VIPERThe Joes kept their paperwork in footlockers. We keep ours in a database with full-text search. Advantage: Cobra.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

A SCAN'S JOURNEY

WHY POLLING?

Normally Paperless notices a new file the instant it lands. Those "a file changed" notifications don't cross an SMB share, so the gate would never hear about it. PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60 makes Paperless simply look in the folder every 60 seconds.

WHAT A WORKER DOES

  • Reads the text with OCR, so a photo becomes searchable
  • Makes an archive PDF next to your original (both are kept)
  • Guesses a date, a correspondent, a document type and tags, learning from what you've filed before
  • Deletes the file from the inbox once it's safely stored

THE CREW

Postgres stores documents, tags and users. Redis is the queue between the web page and the workers. Paperless's Quadlet Requires= both, so systemd starts them first.

PAPERLESS_URL

Paperless only trusts requests for the address it's told it lives at. It's https://papers.songofeo.com. The name used to be docs., and the old value was still in the Quadlet on setup night; we fixed it on 6 November.

WHEN THE SGIN NAPS

If the gate boots while the SGIN is off, the inbox folder isn't there and Paperless fails. Restart=on-failure with RestartSec=60 retries every minute until the SGIN is back. Nothing to do by hand.

TWO LOCKS

papers. is an admin room: Authelia wants your password and a TOTP code, from everywhere. Then Paperless shows its own login, for the superuser made with createsuperuser (eels, made on 6 Nov).

SECRETS

The database password and the secret key were generated once. Quadlets: inside paperless.container (mode 600). Scripts: podman secrets.

IT GUESSESFROMYOU CAN
DateDates printed in the textFix it once; the rest are usually right
CorrespondentWho sent it (Xfinity, the bank...)Set matching rules or let it learn ("auto")
Document typeBill, receipt, letter, manualMake the types you care about
TagsWords and past filingUse tags like "taxes" or "house" across everything

The search box reads the OCR'd text, not just titles. Type "warranty" or a model number and Paperless finds the page it's printed on.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

The Archive was the trickiest room on setup night. Every one of these happened, or nearly did.

THE CHOWN DISASTER

Re-running the manual's chown -R podsvc: /srv/gate after setup took Postgres's files away from its user (999 inside the container). Paperless crash-looped: could not open file "global/pg_filenode.map": Permission denied.As podsvc: podman unshare chown -R 999:999 /srv/gate/postgres, then restart postgres and paperless.

THE OLD ADDRESS

PAPERLESS_URL still said docs. after the rename to papers., so Paperless distrusted its own address.Set it to https://papers.songofeo.com in paperless.container, daemon-reload, restart.

THE STACKED FSTAB

Running the CIFS mount step more than once left eight copies of the same line in /etc/fstab.Cleaned to one line on 6 Nov (backup /etc/fstab.bak-before-cleanup). The manual's grep -q ... || guard now stops repeats.

THE WRONG SAMBA PASSWORD

The gate logs in to the SGIN's share as user gate. A wrong password in /root/smb-gate.cred means no inbox at all.On the SGIN, sudo smbpasswd gate sets a new one; put it in the cred file with nano, never on the command line.

THE IMPATIENT START

The first start migrates the database for minutes. Killing it halfway means starting again.Give it a few minutes and follow podman logs -f paperless.

THE VANISHING INBOX

Paperless deletes files from scans after filing them. That's by design, but it surprises people looking for the original there.The original is in Paperless: open the document and download it.

THE DOUBLE SCAN

Drop the same file twice and Paperless refuses the second copy as a duplicate. The file isn't lost, it's just not filed again.Check the log line, then delete the extra copy.

THE TOTP WALL

papers. is an admin room, so even at home it asks for a password and a TOTP code.Register TOTP on THE-BOX first (Authelia's boss page).

UPDATES

Paperless is one of three apps (with Authelia and RomM) whose release notes you read before podman auto-update: they sometimes change settings between major versions. Run podman auto-update --dry-run first to see what would change.

POSTGRES

The Filing Cabinet: Paperless's memory, one table at a time

Postgres is the database Paperless keeps its brain in: every document's title, date, tags, correspondent, owner and notes, plus the users and settings. You never open it. You'd only notice it if it stopped, because then Paperless stops too.

It runs in its own container in the gate pod, listening on 127.0.0.1:5432 where only its neighbours can reach it. Its whole world is one folder, /srv/gate/postgres, mounted into the container as /var/lib/postgresql/data. The database is called paperless, and so is its user.

The image is pinned to version 16 (postgres:16). AutoUpdate=registry pulls new 16.x releases (bug and security fixes), but never jumps to 17 by itself, and that's on purpose: a database folder made by 16 can't be opened by 17 without an upgrade step.

CLAUDE-VIPERThe scanned files themselves aren't in here. They sit in Paperless's media folder. Postgres holds the card catalogue that says what each one is.

THE PASSWORD HANDSHAKE

Postgres sets the paperless user's password once, the first time it starts with an empty folder. Paperless must then use the same one. The manual generated it as PGPW and wrote it into both Quadlet files; the scripts keep it as the podman secret paperless-db-password.

Change it later in one place only and Paperless can't log in. Moving from Quadlets to scripts? Hand the old value to paperless.sh once, as PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=....

WHO OWNS THE FILES

Inside the container Postgres runs as user 999. Rootless podman maps that to a high "sub-UID" on the gate, not to podsvc. So on the gate, ls -ln /srv/gate/postgres shows a big number as owner. That's correct, and it's exactly what chown -R wrecks.

READY OR NOT

pg_isready is Postgres's own "are you up?" check. paperless.sh waits on it for up to two minutes before starting Paperless. With Quadlets, After=postgres.service orders the start, and Paperless retries on its own.

BACKUP

/srv/gate/postgres is inside VM 110, so the nightly snapshot backup to PBS carries it. Paperless's own exporter (previous chapter) is the app-level copy. A pg_dump gives a third, plain-SQL copy.

WHY NOT SQLITE?

Paperless could use a single SQLite file, but its background workers write at the same time as the web page. Postgres handles that crowd without locking up.

SETTINGVALUEWHY
POSTGRES_DBpaperlessThe database made on first start
POSTGRES_USERpaperlessIts owner, the login Paperless uses
POSTGRES_PASSWORDgenerated once, never printedMust match PAPERLESS_DBPASS

HEALTH CHECKLIST

  • podman ps says postgres is Up
  • pg_isready says accepting connections
  • Its log has no "Permission denied"
  • Paperless's dashboard loads
CLAUDE-VIPERQuiet is good. A healthy Postgres logs almost nothing after it starts. A chatty one is telling you something.

PRO TIP: A SQL BACKUP

pg_dump writes the whole database as one SQL file. Put it in Paperless's export folder so it sits with the rest.

PRO TIP: SEE THE OWNER

podman unshare ls -ln /srv/gate/postgres shows ownership as the container sees it: it should say 999.

THE CHOWN DISASTER

The manual's chown -R podsvc: /srv/gate is for the first setup only. Re-run later, it handed Postgres's files to podsvc, and Postgres (999) could no longer read global/pg_filenode.map.podman unshare chown -R 999:999 /srv/gate/postgres, then restart postgres and paperless.

THE BIG JUMP

Changing the image to postgres:17 on an existing folder makes Postgres refuse to start: the data was written by 16.Stay on 16. A major upgrade means a dump, a fresh folder, and a restore. Plan it, don't stumble into it.

THE PASSWORD SPLIT

Postgres only reads POSTGRES_PASSWORD on an empty folder. Editing it later changes nothing inside the database, but Paperless starts using the new one.Leave both values alone.

THE EXPOSED PORT

5432 must never appear in the gate's listening ports.ss -tlnH as eels: only 22, 80, 443 and 9090.

THE BIG-JUMP PLAYBOOK

Someday Postgres 16 will be old. The safe shape of a major upgrade, for when that day comes (read Paperless's and Postgres's notes first):

  1. Run Paperless's document exporter and a pg_dump. Two copies.
  2. Stop paperless, then postgres.
  3. Move /srv/gate/postgres aside (never delete it) and make an empty folder.
  4. Change the image tag, start postgres on the empty folder, restore the dump, start paperless.

REDIS

The Message Runner: Paperless's to-do list, at lightning speed

Redis is a tiny, fast, in-memory data store. On Cobra Island it has one job: carry messages between Paperless's web page and its background workers. "New scan in the inbox, please OCR it" goes into Redis; a worker picks it up, does the job, and posts the result back.

It lives in the gate pod on 127.0.0.1:6379, next to Paperless and Postgres. It has no web page and no login, which is fine because nothing outside the pod can reach it. Its folder /srv/gate/redis holds a snapshot of the queue so a restart doesn't forget work in progress.

Paperless's workers are run by a task system that needs a "broker" to pass jobs around. That broker is Redis: PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://127.0.0.1:6379. Without it, the web page still opens, but nothing gets consumed, and scans pile up in the inbox.

CLAUDE-VIPEREvery good army needs a runner. Redis never sleeps, never complains, and never reads the messages it carries.

PING? PONG!

CARRIES

Jobs: consume this file, rebuild the index, train the matcher, send results back.

DOESN'T CARRY

Your documents. They go from the inbox to Paperless's media folder directly.

IF IT'S LOST

Only queued jobs. Your archive is safe in Postgres and the media folder.

ASK CLAUDE-VIPER

Do any other apps use this Redis?
No, only Paperless. RomM on the SGIN keeps its own small Redis inside its container (its /redis-data folder).
Does it need backups?
Not really. It only holds jobs in flight. The VM backup has it anyway.

PRO TIP: THE NAME

Redis stands for REmote DIctionary Server: a big table of keys and values, kept in memory. Paperless's queue is just a few of those keys.

CLAUDE-VIPER'S VISUAL FIELD GUIDESCOBRA ISLAND EDITION25
WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

ONE SCAN, TWO HALVES OF PAPERLESS

1 POLLERnew file in scans
▶
2 REDISjob queued
▶
3 WORKERtakes the job
▶
4 OCR + FILEmedia, Postgres
▶
5 REDIS"done!"

IN MEMORY, MOSTLY

Redis keeps everything in RAM, which is why it's fast. Every so often it writes a snapshot to /data (our /srv/gate/redis), and reads it back when it starts. A queue of a few jobs is a few kilobytes.

WHY A QUEUE?

OCR on a 20-page scan can take a minute or more. If the web page did it itself, your browser would hang. With a queue, the page answers at once ("got it") and a worker grinds away in the background. You can upload ten files and keep browsing.

NO PASSWORD?

Redis here runs without a password. That's only safe because it listens inside the pod: the gate publishes nothing but nginx's 80 and 443, and the gate's own firewall drops everything else.

START ORDER

Paperless's Quadlet has Requires=postgres.service redis.service and After= the same. So systemd starts Redis before Paperless, and stopping Redis stops Paperless too.

VERSION PIN

The image is redis:7. Auto-updates bring 7.x fixes only. Paperless only needs a working broker, so there's no reason to chase the newest major.

IN THE BACKUP

It's in /srv/gate, so the nightly VM backup has it, but you'd never need to restore it. An empty Redis just means an empty to-do list.

IF REDIS IS...YOU'LL SEEDO THIS
UpScans leave the inbox within a minute or twoNothing
Downpapers. opens, but scans pile up in scansRestart redis and paperless
Can't write /dataPermission errors in podman logs redisFix the folder's owner (page 3)

HEALTH CHECKLIST

  • redis-cli ping answers PONG
  • Its log has no permission errors
  • The scans inbox empties within minutes

ITS NEIGHBOURS

  • paperless, 127.0.0.1:8000: its only client
  • postgres, 127.0.0.1:5432: the other crew member
  • nginx: never talks to it
CLAUDE-VIPERWant to watch the runner run? redis-cli monitor prints every command live. Drop a scan in the inbox and see the job fly by. Ctrl+C to stop.
CLAUDE-VIPER'S VISUAL FIELD GUIDESCOBRA ISLAND EDITION26
WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
TIPS & TRAPSCODES + SABOTAGE

CODES

GATE · podsvc podman exec redis redis-cli ping PONG means it's alive. podman exec redis redis-cli info memory How much RAM it's using (used_memory_human). podman exec -it redis redis-cli monitor Every command, live. Ctrl+C to stop. podman logs --tail 20 redis

PRO TIP: STUCK SCANS?

Files sitting in scans for more than a couple of minutes? Ping Redis first. If it answers, look at Paperless's log next.

PRO TIP: RESTART THE CREW

Restarting only Redis can leave Paperless's workers confused. Restart the three together, in order.

CODES

GATE · podsvc systemctl --user restart redis paperless

THE SILENT STALL

Redis down, Paperless still shows its web page. Everything looks fine, but nothing gets consumed and the inbox fills up.Ping it. Uptime Kuma watches web pages, not Redis, so this one you check by hand.

THE EXPOSED RUNNER

A passwordless Redis reachable from the network is a classic break-in route.Never publish 6379. ss -tlnH on the gate must not show it.

THE OWNERSHIP TRAP

Like Postgres, Redis runs as its own user inside the container. A later chown -R podsvc: /srv/gate can leave it unable to write its snapshot.Don't re-run that chown. If Redis logs permission errors on /data, fix its folder the way you fixed Postgres's.

THE "FLUSH IT" URGE

Wiping Redis to "fix" Paperless throws away queued jobs, and their scans may already have left the inbox.Restart, don't flush.

FIELD TEST: WATCH THE RUNNER

  1. GATE, podsvc: start podman exec -it redis redis-cli monitor in your Windows Terminal SSH tab.
  2. THE-BOX: save a small PDF into \\cobra-stream\scans.
  3. Within a minute, lines scroll past as the poller queues the job and a worker takes it.
  4. Ctrl+C, then find the document on papers.

METUBE

The Tape Deck: paste a video link, it lands in your Jellyfin library

MeTube is a web page with one box: paste a video link, pick a quality, press Add. Behind it, the famous downloader yt-dlp fetches the video and saves it into the library's youtube folder, where Jellyfin can show it on every TV in the house.

It runs in the gate pod on 127.0.0.1:8081, behind nginx and Authelia's two-factor sign-in at metube.songofeo.com. It's an admin room: anyone who could reach it could fill your drives.

The finished videos don't stay on the gate. They go over the CIFS mount to the SGIN's wd2/youtube, a folder on the Seagate's spare space that appears as /media/wd2/youtube to Jellyfin. MeTube's own queue, history and half-finished downloads stay on the gate in /srv/gate/metube, so a big download doesn't trickle over the network a piece at a time.

CLAUDE-VIPERThe Joes had VHS tapes in their footlockers. We have a tape deck that never runs out of tape. Well, until the Seagate fills up.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

FROM LINK TO LIVING ROOM TV

1 THE-BOXpaste link
▶
2 METUBEqueues it

▶

YT-DLP INSIDE

MeTube is a friendly face on yt-dlp, the command-line downloader. yt-dlp does the real work: finds the video's streams, picks the quality you asked for, downloads, and joins sound and picture into one file.

WHY IT AGES FAST

Video sites change their pages often, and yt-dlp ships fixes to keep up. A MeTube image a few weeks old can suddenly fail on every link. The cure is a newer image: that's why the run script ends with "yt-dlp ages fast".

WEBSOCKETS

The progress bars update live over a websocket. nginx keeps those open (proxy_read_timeout 1h on the admin block), so a long download doesn't freeze the page.

WHEN THE SGIN IS OFF

No SGIN, no wd2/youtube, and MeTube can't start. Its Quadlet has Restart=on-failure every 60 seconds, so it comes back by itself once the share does. up-all.sh also lists it as "did not start" without stopping the other apps.

THE WRITE PERMISSION

MeTube runs as a non-root user inside its container, an unnamed ID on the gate. The CIFS mount uses file_mode=0666,dir_mode=0777 so that user may write. On the SGIN, the files still land as user gate, group media.

NOT BACKED UP

The Seagate's wd2 folder is spare space lent to the library. It's on the same drive as the backups, so it isn't backed up. Fine for videos you could download again.

YOU PASTEMETUBE DOES
A single video linkDownloads that one video at the quality you picked
A playlist linkQueues every video in it, one after another
A link from another siteWorks if yt-dlp supports that site (it knows a great many)
A link with "audio" chosenSaves just the sound

ASK CLAUDE-VIPER

Can Rachel use it?
Only with TOTP registered, since it's an admin room. Easier: send her links to the Commander.
Where do downloads go at first?
/state/tmp on the gate's disk, then the finished file moves to wd2/youtube on the SGIN.
CLAUDE-VIPEROnly grab what you have the right to keep, Commander. Even Cobra respects a creator's terms. Mostly.

TIPS & TRICKSPOWER-UPS

PRO TIP: QUEUE IS SAFE

The queue and history live in /srv/gate/metube. Restart the container mid-download and the queue is still there afterwards.

PRO TIP: JELLYFIN SHELF

In Jellyfin (THE-BOX, browser): Dashboard, Libraries, Add. Type Home Videos and Photos, folder /media/wd2/youtube. New downloads show up after the next library scan.

PRO TIP: AUDIO ONLY

Pick an audio format in the quality menu to grab just the sound: talks, live sets, a podcast episode. Then move the file somewhere a Navidrome can see it.

PRO TIP: WHOLE PLAYLISTS

Paste a playlist link and MeTube queues every video in it. Big playlists take a while; the queue survives a restart.

PRO TIP: THE BOOKMARKLET

MeTube's project README has a bookmarklet. Add it to THE-BOX's bookmarks bar (with your metube. address) and one click sends the video you're watching to the queue.

PRO TIP: FIX "IT STOPPED"

Every link failing at once? It's almost always an old yt-dlp. Pull the newest image and restart.

CODES

PRO TIP: CHANNELS?

MeTube is for one-off grabs. To follow channels automatically, the research notes point at a different app (Pinchflat).

KEEP IT FRESH

The weekly routine from manual 5.7 covers MeTube: as podsvc, podman auto-update --dry-run lists images with a newer version, and podman auto-update pulls them and restarts those containers, rolling back if one fails to start. MeTube's Quadlet has AutoUpdate=registry, so it's included.

PRO TIP: SORT INTO SHOWS

A channel you grab often can get its own subfolder in wd2/youtube (make it in Explorer on THE-BOX, then move the files in). Jellyfin's Home Videos library shows each folder as its own shelf.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

The tape deck jams in a few predictable ways.

THE STALE DOWNLOADER

Weeks without an update and every download fails with an extraction error.Pull and restart (codes, previous page). The weekly podman auto-update catches it too.

THE MISSING SHARE

The SGIN reboots or the gate's Samba password is wrong: MeTube can't find wd2/youtube and keeps restarting.As eels: ls /srv/storage/disks/wd2. Empty or an error means fix the CIFS mount first.

THE STACKED FSTAB

The CIFS mount line got pasted eight times into /etc/fstab on setup night.One line only: grep -n srv/storage/disks /etc/fstab must show exactly one.

THE FULL DRIVE

A runaway playlist can fill the Seagate, which also holds the PBS backups.Check df -h before big grabs and prune old videos.

THE INVISIBLE VIDEOS

Downloads finished but Jellyfin shows nothing: no library points at the folder yet, or no scan has run.Add the Home Videos library, then Scan All Libraries.

THE OPEN DECK

MeTube has no login of its own. Without Authelia in front, anyone could fill your drives.metube. stays in the two_factor rule and its server block keeps auth_request.

THE GATE DISK SQUEEZE

Partial downloads sit on the gate's 64 GB disk until they finish. A giant 4K grab can crowd it.Grab huge files one at a time, and check df -h /srv/gate.

THE ODD FILE NAMES

Video titles become file names, emoji and all. Jellyfin copes, but sorting can look messy.Rename in Explorer on THE-BOX via \\cobra-stream if it bothers you.

  3. As eels on the gate: ls /srv/storage/disks/wd2/youtube shows the file.

HOMEPAGE

Command: one screen, a tile for every app, a live dot on each

Homepage is the island's command console at command.songofeo.com: a dark dashboard with one tile per app, grouped into rows, each tile a link with a little dot that turns red the moment that app stops answering.

It's a single container in the gate pod on 127.0.0.1:3000, behind Authelia's two-factor sign-in. There's no database and no settings screen: the whole dashboard is two YAML text files in /srv/gate/homepage. Edit a file, save, and Homepage redraws by itself.

The name used to be home., then throne.; the Commander settled on command. on 5 November. The research notes add a correction worth repeating: Homepage shows your apps and their status, but it doesn't start, stop or update containers.

CLAUDE-VIPEREvery villain's lair needs a wall of glowing screens. This is ours, and the dots really do glow red when something breaks.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

HOW A DOT GETS ITS COLOR

1 YAMLsiteMonitor URL
▶
2 HOMEPAGEasks it
▶
3 APPanswers or not
▶
4 DOTgreen or red

TWO FILES

settings.yaml is the look: title "Cobra", dark theme, slate color, and how many columns each row gets. services.yaml is the tiles: a name, the link (href), an icon, an optional description and the siteMonitor address to check.

BACKSTAGE ADDRESSES

The link you click is the public name (https://tv.songofeo.com). The dot checks the app's back door directly: http://10.6.9.20:8096 for Jellyfin, http://127.0.0.1:8000 for Paperless. So a dot tests the app itself, not nginx or Authelia.

ALLOWED HOSTS

Homepage only answers requests for the names it's told about: HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=command.songofeo.com. That stops other sites from loading your dashboard by pointing a different name at it.

NO DOT FOR THREE

Proxmox, OPNsense and PBS use self-signed certificates, which Homepage's checker rejects. Their tiles are plain links. Uptime Kuma watches them instead, with "ignore TLS errors".

STARTER FILES

The first run of homepage.sh copies the starter settings.yaml and services.yaml from the repo. Later runs see the files are there and keep your edits. The manual's part 5.7 writes the same two files by hand.

ICONS

Names like jellyfin.png come from Homepage's built-in icon set; mdi-trophy is a Material Design icon. No image files to upload.

ASK CLAUDE-VIPER

Why does ErsatzTV's tile link to an address, not a name?
ErsatzTV is LAN only and has no songofeo.com name. The tile goes straight to http://10.6.9.20:8409.
Vaultwarden's tile won't open on cellular.
Correct: vault. is LAN and WireGuard only. Turn WireGuard on.

ONE TILE, DECODED

- Music: { href: "https://music.songofeo.com", icon: navidrome.png, siteMonitor: "http://10.6.9.20:4533" }

Name Music; click goes to the public name through the gate; icon from the built-in set; the dot asks the Navidrome on the SGIN directly.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

Small traps, but they make the whole dashboard go dark.

THE WRONG NAME

Opening Homepage by any name other than command.songofeo.com (an old home. bookmark, say) gets an error instead of the dashboard.Use command. If you add a name, add it to HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS too.

THE TAB CHARACTER

One tab or a wrong indent in a YAML file and Homepage shows an error instead of tiles.Spaces only. Read podman logs homepage for the line number.

THE FOREVER-RED DOT

Pointing a siteMonitor at a self-signed https address (Proxmox, OPNsense, PBS) keeps that dot red forever.Leave those tiles without a dot and let Uptime Kuma watch them.

THE OVERWRITE FEAR

Running homepage.sh again does not overwrite your files: it only copies the starters when they're missing. But pasting the manual's 5.7 block again does overwrite.After you've customised, don't re-paste 5.7. Make a .bak first.

THE LEAKY KEY

Widget API keys sit in services.yaml in plain text.Keep the file podsvc-only, and give widgets read-only keys where the app offers them.

THE "IT'S ALL GREEN" LIE

A green dot means the app answered Homepage, from inside the gate. It doesn't prove the public name or the sign-in works.That's what check.sh and Uptime Kuma's public-name monitors are for.

THE WRONG BACK DOOR

A typo in a siteMonitor port (4353 for 4533) paints a healthy app red.Compare with the port list in scripts/podman/sgin/pod.sh and gate/pod.sh.

THE STALE COPY

The copies of the scripts in the project files are older than the repo. Their Homepage starters may miss tiles.The repo is the source of truth.

UPTIME KUMA

Status: checks every app every minute, and shouts when one falls over

Uptime Kuma is the island's sentry. Every minute or so it knocks on every app, every router and both Pi-holes. When one doesn't answer, it turns the monitor red and sends you a notification. When it comes back, it tells you that too.

It lives in the gate pod on 127.0.0.1:3001, behind Authelia's two-factor sign-in at status.songofeo.com, with its own admin login on top. Version 2 (the image is pinned to uptime-kuma:2). Everything it knows, monitors, history and settings, is in /srv/gate/uptime-kuma.

status. has no public DNS record: from outside the house the name doesn't resolve at all. At home and over WireGuard the Pi-holes answer it, so you check it from THE-BOX or from the phone with WireGuard on.

CLAUDE-VIPERHomepage's dots tell you when you look. Kuma tells you when you don't. That's the difference between a dashboard and an alarm.

WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

A PUBLIC-NAME CHECK, FROM INSIDE THE GATE

1 KUMAcheck tv.
▶
2 PI-HOLEtv. = 10.6.9.10
▶
3 NGINXTLS, server block
▶
4 JELLYFIN10.6.9.20:8096
▶
5 VERDICTup or down

WHY PUBLIC NAMES WORK

The gate's DNS servers are the two Pi-holes (set at install: 10.6.9.3 and 10.6.9.20). They answer every *.songofeo.com name with 10.6.9.10, so Kuma checking https://tv.songofeo.com goes through the gate's own nginx to the app. One monitor tests the certificate, nginx and the app together.

HEARTBEATS

Each check is a "heartbeat": green bar for up, red for down. Kuma keeps the history, so you can see when something has been flaky all week, not just whether it's up right now.

WEBSOCKETS

The dashboard updates live over a websocket. nginx keeps it open for an hour (proxy_read_timeout 1h in the admin block).

THE PROTECTED ROOMS

A check on papers. from the gate gets Authelia's redirect to the sign-in, not Paperless. That still proves nginx and Authelia are up. To check the app behind it, point a monitor at its back door instead, like http://127.0.0.1:8000: Kuma is in the same pod.

NOTIFICATIONS

Settings, Notifications: Kuma can send to email and many phone and chat services. Make one, then attach it to every monitor (there's a "default enabled" switch so new monitors get it too).

VERSION 2

Uptime Kuma 2.0 went stable in October 2025. The image tag :2 keeps you on 2.x updates without jumping to a future 3.

YOU SEEIT MEANSLOOK AT
One red monitorThat app stopped answeringIts chapter here, then podman logs
All SGIN apps redThe SGIN or its network link is downThe SGIN itself (power, USB network adapter)
Everything redDNS, or nginxThe DNS monitors first, then podman logs nginx
FlickeringUp and down all dayThe heartbeat bar's history; often a slow app timing out
CLAUDE-VIPERIf BOTH Pi-holes go down, every public-name monitor turns red at once, even though the apps are fine. A wall of red usually means DNS, not twenty broken apps.

PRO TIP: RESPONSE TIMES

Each HTTP monitor also graphs how long the app took to answer. A slowly climbing line warns you before the red ever shows up.

CLAUDE-VIPER'S VISUAL FIELD GUIDESCOBRA ISLAND EDITION37
WORLD 1 · THE GATEVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
TIPS & TRICKSPOWER-UPS

PRO TIP: CLAIM IT FIRST

Kuma's very first visit asks you to create the admin account. Do it on THE-BOX right away, with a generated password saved in Vaultwarden.

PRO TIP: MONITOR GROUPS

Group monitors as World 1 (gate apps), World 2 (SGIN apps) and Network (Proxmox, OPNsense, Pi-holes). A whole group going red points straight at the machine.

PRO TIP: KEYWORD CHECKS

An HTTP monitor can also look for a word on the page. Checking that tv. contains "Jellyfin" catches the case where nginx answers but serves the wrong thing.

PRO TIP: THE HISCORE BEAT

When the hiscore board is live, add an HTTP monitor for http://127.0.0.1:8090/healthz. Same pod, so no sign-in in the way.

PRO TIP: QUIET HOURS

Planning to reboot the SGIN? Pause its monitors, or set a maintenance window, so your phone doesn't buzz for every app on it.

PRO TIP: CERT WATCH

The Scoreboard: every cabinet high score, newest first, kept forever

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

A NEW RECORD ON THE CABINET

1 RETROARCHwrites galaga.hi
▶
2 CABINETplugin + agent
▶
3 NGINXPUT /upload/
▶
4 HISCORE127.0.0.1:8090
▶
5 BOARDNEW badge

TWO UPLOADERS

The LaunchBox plugin uploads the moment a game closes and adds what only LaunchBox knows: the proper title and platform. The hiscore agent checks every 15 seconds, catches games started outside LaunchBox, and retries while the network is down. Both upload; the server ignores a file it already has.

THE API KEY

python -m hiscore hash-key cabinet prints a key and a line for keys.txt. The cabinet keeps the key; the server keeps only its hash in /srv/gate/hiscore/keys.txt. To replace a key, make a new one and swap the line.

WHAT'S IN A .HI FILE

A copy of the game's memory, not text. Reading it needs a per-game definition: hi2txt on the cabinet through the plugin, or a decoder on the server (HISCORE_DECODER). Games nothing can read still list, as "Score table saved".

LOCKED-DOWN NGINX

Its server block opens only three paths without Authelia: /upload/ (PUT only, 256 KB max), /public/ and /screen (GET only). Everything else, the board itself, needs the sign-in. Viewers need a password, not TOTP.

THE ARCADE SCREEN

/screen cycles through each game's top scores with a ticker of the latest. The server lets songofeo.com show it in a frame and no other site. Options: ?embed=1, ?seconds=8, ?game=galaga, ?demo=1.

PUBLIC OR NOT

With HISCORE_PUBLIC=1 (the Quadlet in part 7.3 sets it), anyone can read titles, initials and scores, so the screen on songofeo.com works for visitors. Without it, visitors see demo scores and only signed-in people see real ones.

SystemThe RetroArch core folder, e.g. fbneo
Last updatedWhen the server received a changed file
Versions + downloadEvery distinct upload, kept in raw/

THE PUBLIC BOARD, ONE ENTRY

{"game": "galaga", "title": "Galaga", "system": "fbneo", "scores": [{"rank": "1", "score": "52310", "name": "EEL"}]}

/public/v1/board: newest first, up to 100 games (?limit= up to 500), at most 10 scores each.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

THE CINEMA PAGE ASKS FOR A BACKDROP

A FLOOR, NOT A ROOM

art.songofeo.com is in nginx's $station map, next to music. and books., and in Authelia's floor rule. So it opens straight away at home and over WireGuard, and asks for one password elsewhere. Signed in on the station, the landing pages' pictures just load.

NO PUBLIC NAME (YET)

Manual 5.5 gives art no Porkbun record for now. At home and over WireGuard the Pi-holes answer it; from outside it doesn't resolve, so visitors there see each page's drawn artwork instead of live pictures.

THE PLAYERS' CORS FILE

The station's pages live on Porkbun's hosting and call the floors from there, so nginx answers them with CORS headers from station-cors.inc. That file came from Project-Eo (home/nginx/station-cors.inc) with eo_art.py.

RESCANS ITSELF

eo-art looks at its five folders every two minutes. Drop new pictures in and they join the rotation without a restart.

404 IS FINE

An empty folder answers 404, and the page falls back to its drawn art. The run script's health check counts any HTTP answer, 404 included, as "up".

NO CURL INSIDE

python:3-slim has no curl or wget, so health checks ask with Python's urllib from inside the container.

READ-ONLY EVERYTHING

The script folder is mounted :ro and the pictures are mounted read-only. eo-art can't change a single file, on the gate or on the SGIN.

EO-ART ANSWERSTHE PAGE SHOWS
A pictureYour picture, picked at random from that folder
404 (folder empty)The page's own drawn artwork
Sign-in redirect (outside, not signed in)Drawn artwork until you sign in on the station
Nothing (eo-art down)Drawn artwork; nginx logs a 502

WHEN THE SGIN NAPS

Like Paperless and MeTube, eo-art needs the SGIN's share. Its Quadlet has Restart=on-failure every 60 seconds, so it comes back once the share does, and up-all.sh lists it as "did not start" without holding up the rest of the gate.

JELLYFIN

The Cinema: movies, shows and Live TV at tv.songofeo.com

Jellyfin is the headliner of World 2. It reads every movie and show on the drives, dresses them up with posters and descriptions, and plays them on the TVs, phones and browsers of everyone you let in. When a screen can't play a file as it is, Jellyfin re-encodes it on the fly with the SGIN's Intel GPU.

It lives in the stream pod on cobra-stream (10.6.9.20) and answers on port 8096. Its own files, the database, posters and watch history, sit on the SGIN's internal SSD under /srv/stream/jellyfin. The movies themselves come in read-only from /srv/storage/disks, which the container sees as /media. Jellyfin can look at your library all day long; it can never delete a frame of it.

From outside, it's tv.songofeo.com, and it is the one floor that skips the gate's sign-in. Friends' Roku, Apple TV and phone apps can't show Authelia's login page, so tv. has its own nginx block with no auth_request, and Jellyfin's own login does the guarding.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

A FRIEND PRESSES PLAY

1 TV APPserver: https://tv.songofeo.com
▶
2 OPNSENSEWAN 443 to the gate
▶
3 NGINXtv. block, no Authelia
▶

▶

THE VIDEO POOL

wd1 (the WD 6 TB) and wd2 (a folder on the Seagate 24 TB) are joined by mergerfs into one folder, /srv/storage/disks/video. It's only a view: every file sits whole on one drive, and either drive reads fine on its own.

New files land on wd1 first (category.create=ff) and spill onto wd2 only once wd1 is down to 100 GB free. That matters, because wd2 lives on the backup drive itself and has no second copy. Keep wd2 for things you could download again.

wd1 and wd2 are the only drives that are ever pooled. Music, books and the rest stay one-drive-one-job, so you always know where a file lives.

THE THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Direct Play: the screen plays the file as it is. Zero work for the SGIN. Direct Stream: only the wrapper or audio changes. Cheap. Transcode: the video is decoded and re-encoded live, which is where Quick Sync earns its keep (next page).

HOW THE CONTAINER IS WIRED

  • /dev/dri is handed in, and keep-groups lets the container keep podsvc's render group, so it may open the GPU
  • /media is ro,rbind: read-only, and rbind carries each drive's own mount in, so /media/wd1 is really wd1
  • No :Z on the library, because Samba shares the same folders
  • /transcode-ram: a 4 GB RAM scratch area (scripts only), if you ever want transcodes off the SSD
  • JELLYFIN_PublishedServerUrl tells apps the address is https://tv.songofeo.com

WHO IS WATCHING?

Every remote viewer arrives through the gate, so without help Jellyfin would think they're all one LAN client called 10.6.9.10. Setting Known proxies: 10.6.9.10 makes Jellyfin read the real address from nginx's X-Forwarded-For. Then remote bitrate limits work, and Dashboard → Activity shows who's really there.

FRIENDS IN THE PIPE

ErsatzTV's channels show up under Live TV, and the cobra-breaks helper builds "with breaks" playlists. Both talk to Jellyfin over 127.0.0.1 inside the pod (chapter 2-2 and the tips page).

FIRST-RUN WIZARD

  1. the-box, browser: http://10.6.9.20:8096 → language → admin user eels and a strong password (save it in Vaultwarden).
  2. Add Media Library: Movies → /media/video/movies; again for Shows → /media/video/series. Music and books skip Jellyfin: they live in Navidrome and Audiobookshelf.
  3. Allow remote connections: on. Newer Jellyfin has no automatic port mapping, which is exactly what we want: the gate is the only way in.
  4. Then the Transcoding settings (next page) and Known proxies: 10.6.9.10.
CLAUDE-VIPER'S VISUAL FIELD GUIDESCOBRA ISLAND EDITION49
WORLD 2 · THE STREAMVIPER VISIONYOU AND YOUR POD!
QUICK SYNC TURBO MODEHIDDEN POWER

The SGIN's Celeron N5095A is a small chip with a big secret: an Intel GPU with Quick Sync, a block of silicon built only for decoding and encoding video. With it switched on, one tiny laptop board can turn a 4K HEVC movie into 1080p H.264 for a phone without breaking a sweat.

INSIDE A TRANSCODE

FILEHEVC 10-bit HDR
▶
DECODEQSV hardware
▶
TONE MAPVPP: HDR to SDR
▶
ENCODElow-power H.264
▶
SCREENplays smoothly

THE HUC KEY

Jasper Lake can only encode in low-power mode, and low-power mode needs the HuC firmware loaded into the GPU. On Debian 13 that firmware moved into its own package, firmware-intel-graphics, and the driver option enable_guc=2 in /etc/modprobe.d/i915.conf tells i915 to load it.

Without it, decoding still works, so everything looks fine, but every transcode fails. The Quick Sync media driver itself, intel-media-va-driver-non-free, lives in Debian's non-free section, which the installer leaves switched off.

CODES

PRO TIP: WATCH THE ENGINE

While a movie transcodes, sudo intel_gpu_top (as eels) shows the Video row busy. At 0% while htop shows ffmpeg eating the CPU, the transcode is in software. q quits.

PRO TIP: ONE PER FRIEND

Dashboard → Users → +. Per user you choose which libraries they see, whether they may download, and a remote bitrate cap. The manual sets users hidden (no name list on the login screen) and Quick Connect off, so nobody can pair a TV to an account without a password.

PRO TIP: APP ADDRESS

In any Jellyfin app, the server is https://tv.songofeo.com with no port. Same address at home, on cellular and on WireGuard; at home the Pi-holes send it straight to the gate inside the house.

PRO TIP: EPISODE BREAKS

Jellyfin apps only ask for intros before movies, never episodes, and the Roku and Apple TV apps ignore web plugins. So cobra-breaks (manual part 6) builds a playlist per show and person, "<Show> — with breaks": episode, filler, episode. It starts at each person's next unwatched episode and rebuilds every day at 4:00.

Every break must be a different video (Jellyfin drops repeats from a playlist), so 40 episodes need 39+ filler videos of 3 minutes or less in wd1/filler.

CODES

SGIN · podsvc podman exec cobra-breaks python -m cobra_breaks run --config /config/breaks.toml Rebuild the playlists now, after editing breaks.toml or adding filler.

PRO TIP: LIVE TV

Jellyfin → Live TV shows ErsatzTV's channels with a real program guide, on every app, at home and away. Remote viewers watch through Jellyfin; ErsatzTV itself never leaves the LAN.

PRO TIP: MOVIE PRE-ROLLS

Movies get their intro from the Local Intros plugin, fed from wd1/pre-rolls. Live TV channels get breaks from ErsatzTV. Three kinds of break, three different tools, and every app plays all of them.

In the web player, ⚙ → Playback Info, or Dashboard → Activity, names the play method and the reason. That one word tells you which fix on the next page to use.

Dashboard → API Keys → +. Make one key per helper (ersatztv, cobra-breaks) so you can revoke one without breaking the others.

STUTTER BUSTERSMANUAL 3.8C

"Only some movies stutter" is almost never the file size. A 4 GB two-hour movie averages about 4.5 Mbps, which anything here handles easily. The big files are usually HEVC 10-bit or HDR, often with PGS or ASS subtitles, and when the screen can't play those, Jellyfin transcodes. The stutter comes from that transcode.

FIND THE REASON FIRST!
REASON SHOWNFIX
Subtitle codec not supportedThe subtitles are being burned in. Turn them off and retest; then pick an SRT track, or set the user's subtitle mode to Smart with image subtitles off by default. The single most common cause.
Video codec not supportedUse a client that plays HEVC 10-bit itself: the Android TV / Fire TV app, Jellyfin Media Player, Swiftfin or Infuse. In a browser, Chrome or Edge rather than Firefox.
Bitrate exceeds limitClient app → Maximum streaming quality → Auto or highest. Over WireGuard, Dashboard → Playback → Streaming → raise the remote limit.
Audio codec not supportedCheap, rarely the stutter. Allow passthrough, or pick the AC3 track.

STILL STUTTERS?

Dashboard → Logs → newest FFmpeg.Transcode-…log. The encoder must be h264_qsv or hevc_qsv. libx264 or libx265 means the CPU is doing it: recheck the HuC page.

SMOOTH BUT JERKY

Never buffers, but pans judder? That's a 24 fps film on a 60 Hz TV. Turn on match frame rate (refresh rate switching) in the TV's app.

WIRED VS WI-FI

Retest once with the TV on Ethernet. Smooth wired but not on Wi-Fi means the Wi-Fi is the problem, not Jellyfin. From outside, Xfinity's upload speed is the cap.

CODES

SGIN · eels sudo dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'uas|reset|i/o error' | tail -20 lsusb -t Every drive at 5000M. 480M = it fell back to USB 2.

PRO TIP: FOREVER FIX

The best transcode is the one that never happens. A better app on the one TV that keeps transcoding fixes the whole library at once.

THE STUTTER SPEEDRUN

1 PLAYthe bad movie
▶
2 INFOPlayback Info: the reason
▶
3 FIXthe table above
▶
4 LOGh264_qsv or libx264?
▶
5 GPUvainfo + intel_gpu_top
CLAUDE-VIPERIs the SGIN the right box for this? Yes. With Quick Sync working end to end it handles several 4K-to-1080p transcodes at once. Moving Jellyfin to the Latitude wouldn't fix a stutter; finding the reason does.

JOE SABOTAGE REPORT

Pulled from the footlockers, manual parts 3.3 to 3.8c, and the build itself.

THE MISSING HUC

Decode works, the movie list loads, the first transcode dies. Debian 13 moved the GPU firmware out of firmware-misc-nonfree.Install firmware-intel-graphics, keep enable_guc=2, rebuild the initramfs, reboot, and look for EncSliceLP in vainfo.

THE AV1 TICKBOX

Ticking AV1 under hardware decoding looks harmless. Jasper Lake has no AV1 decoder, so AV1 files then fail outright.Leave AV1 unticked; Jellyfin decodes those few files in software.

THE LOCKED GPU DOOR

podsvc not in render, or the container started without keep-groups: the container can't open /dev/dri and everything falls back to the CPU.As eels: sudo usermod -aG render,video podsvc, then log podsvc in again and rerun jellyfin.sh. Its QSV check says pass or fail.

THE GHOST DRIVE

A container sees the drives that were mounted when it started. Replug wd1 and Jellyfin keeps looking at an empty folder, and a scan then marks everything missing.podman pod restart stream first, scan after.

EVERYONE IS THE GATE

Without Known proxies, every remote viewer looks like 10.6.9.10 on the LAN. Remote bitrate limits never kick in and the logs are useless.Dashboard → Networking → Known proxies: 10.6.9.10. Check: play from the-box, Activity shows the-box's address.

THE FIRST-VISITOR CROWN

Until the setup wizard is finished, whoever opens the page first becomes admin.Finish the wizard on the-box right after the container first starts (admin eels).

THE "SHOWS" MIX-UP

The TV folder on wd1 and wd2 is called series. Point a library at /media/video/shows and it stays empty forever.Shows library = /media/video/series.

THE POWER-SAVER AMBUSH

Laptop guides say "install TLP" or "run powertop --auto-tune". On the SGIN both switch on USB autosuspend, which drops the hub, every drive and the network adapter, its only link.Never install TLP or auto-tune here. Looking with powertop is fine.

THE :Z RELABEL

:Z on /srv/storage/disks would relabel the whole library for one container, and Samba shares those folders too.App data gets :Z; the library never does.

ERSATZTV

The Broadcast Tower: real TV channels made from your own library

Remember flipping channels and landing on a rerun you hadn't picked? ErsatzTV brings that back. It builds always-on TV channels out of your movies and shows, complete with a schedule, a program guide and commercial breaks from your filler folder.

It doesn't have viewers of its own. ErsatzTV hands Jellyfin two links, a channel list (M3U) and a program guide (XMLTV), and Jellyfin shows the channels under Live TV on every app: Roku, Apple TV, phones, browsers. Tune in and ErsatzTV starts playing that channel's schedule from wherever "now" is, transcoding it live on the Quick Sync GPU.

Both live in the stream pod, so they talk to each other over 127.0.0.1. ErsatzTV answers on port 8409 for the LAN and WireGuard, has no login page at all, and the gate never publishes it. People away from home watch the channels through Jellyfin at tv.songofeo.com instead.

CLAUDE-VIPERPicture it, Commander: "Cobra Channel 1, all monster movies, all night", with your old bumpers between them. The Joes will never find the remote.

WHERE THE SHOWS COME FROM

Media Sources → Jellyfin: ErsatzTV logs into Jellyfin at http://127.0.0.1:8096 with an API key and syncs the Movies and TV libraries, posters and all.

Media Sources → Local: a library of type Other Videos on /media/wd1/filler for the break videos.

Both containers mount /srv/storage/disks at the same /media path, read-only. So a file path Jellyfin reports is one ErsatzTV can open too. That shared path is the whole trick.

THE GPU, AGAIN

Every channel someone is watching is a live transcode, so ErsatzTV gets the same /dev/dri and keep-groups wiring as Jellyfin. Its FFmpeg profile says: hardware acceleration VAAPI, driver iHD, device /dev/dri/renderD128, H.264 (plays everywhere), 1080p.

THE BUILDING BLOCKS

BLOCKWHAT IT IS
Collection"All of this show" or "these 40 movies"
Smart collectionA saved search, e.g. genre:comedy
PlaylistA fixed order you choose, mixing shows and movies
Filler presetBreaks: Pre-roll before each item, or Pad to the half hour
ScheduleItems + order (chronological, shuffle, random) + filler
ChannelNumber, name, logo, FFmpeg profile, MPEG-TS
PlayoutChannel + schedule, built into a timeline

WHY RAM?

While someone watches, ErsatzTV writes the channel's live video segments to /transcode. That's a 2 GB tmpfs, a folder in RAM, so the constant little writes never wear the SGIN's SSD.

THE TWO MAGIC LINKS

http://127.0.0.1:8409/iptv/channels.m3u

BUILD A CHANNEL IN 6 MOVES

  6. Jellyfin → Dashboard → Live TV: M3U Tuner with the channels link, XMLTV with the guide link → Refresh Guide Data.

PRO TIP: REAL TV TIMING

A Pre-roll filler preset (Mode: Count 1) drops one break before each episode. Add a Pad preset too and ErsatzTV fills each episode out to the next 30-minute mark, so shows start on the hour and half hour like real TV.

PRO TIP: THEME NIGHTS

A smart collection is a saved search that updates itself. genre:comedy today includes the comedy you add next month, with no rebuild of the list.

PRO TIP: REBUILD

Changed a schedule a lot? Playouts → Build again. The guide in Jellyfin catches up on its next refresh, or press Refresh Guide Data yourself.

PRO TIP: THE FILLER STASH

Old commercials, bumpers, station IDs, trailers: drop them in \\cobra-stream\media\wd1\filler from the-box, subfolders allowed. ErsatzTV, cobra-breaks and Jellyfin's Filler library all use that one folder. Aim for 50+.

PRO TIP: CHANNEL LOGOS

Footlocker findings from manual 3.8a and the research notes.

THE OPEN TOWER

ErsatzTV has no login screen. Anyone who reaches port 8409 can rewrite every channel.Never give it a gate hostname. nftables keeps 8409 LAN and WireGuard only; remote viewers use Jellyfin's Live TV.

THE WRONG HOST

THE VAAPI HICCUP

The manual marks the VAAPI profile "verify": some builds error on it.If channels won't start, try QSV with the same device in the FFmpeg profile.

THE IMPOSTOR IMAGE

Old guides say ghcr.io/ersatztv/ersatztv. The maintained line is ghcr.io/ersatztv/legacy (v26.x). A rewrite, ErsatzTV Next, is still in early testing.Stay on legacy until Next calls itself stable.

THE DEAD KEY

Delete or recreate the ersatztv API key in Jellyfin and the sync silently stops finding new episodes.New key → ErsatzTV → Media Sources → Jellyfin → paste → Sync.

THE EMPTY FILLER

A channel with a filler preset but an empty or unscanned filler library plays straight through with no breaks, or gaps.Fill wd1/filler, then Media Sources → Local → Scan.

THE GHOST DRIVE, PART 2

Just like Jellyfin, ErsatzTV only sees drives mounted when it started. Replug wd1 and the channels can't open their files.podman pod restart stream, then rescan.

THE EMPTY GUIDE

Channels added in Jellyfin, but the guide shows "no information" for hours.Dashboard → Live TV → Refresh Guide Data after each new channel or playout build.

NAVIDROME

The Music Floor: one jukebox, a shelf for each person

Navidrome is a small, fast music server. Point it at a folder of songs and it reads their tags, builds an album and artist library, and plays it in a web player or any Subsonic app on your phone. Cobra Island runs one of it.

Since version 0.58 one Navidrome can hold several libraries, and the admin ticks which libraries each user may see. The Commander's music is library Eels, Rachel's is library Rachel. Rachel's account only sees hers; the admin sees both. Her music never lands in your shuffle unless you pick her shelf too.

Two names lead to the same jukebox: music. and mustang.. Stand-up and The Ward moved to Audiobookshelf, which remembers where you stopped in a long track (the last two pages of this chapter).

CLAUDE-VIPEROne jukebox, two shelves, one set of keys per person. Less to feed, less to break, Commander.

HOW IT WORKSLEVEL MAP

RACHEL OPENS MUSTANG. ON CELLULAR

1 BROWSERmustang.songofeo.com
▶
2 AUTHELIAsigns in, says "rachel"; the music wall lets her by
▶

▶

ONE SIGN-IN, NOT TWO

Navidrome runs with ND_REVERSEPROXYWHITELIST=10.6.9.10/32: "if a request comes from the gate and carries a Remote-User header, that person is already signed in." Authelia fills in the header, so Navidrome lets you straight in. It only believes that header from 10.6.9.10, and nginx always wipes any Remote-User header a visitor sends.

THE MUSIC WALL

Navidrome makes an account for anyone the gate signs in. So Authelia has a wall in front of music. and mustang.: only the people listed (eels and rachel) get through, everyone else gets forbidden. gate-music-one.sh writes it; add a name with MUSIC_USERS.

SHELVES DON'T OVERLAP

Navidrome won't let one library sit inside another. That's why the main shelf is music/eels and not all of music/: then music/rachel can be a shelf of its own. A person sees whole shelves, never single folders inside one.

WHY ONE AND NOT FOUR?

Four Navidromes don't serve four people any faster. One already streams to many at once; playing a song is just reading a file, and a transcode costs the same CPU in any container. Extra instances only add RAM, another scan of the same disk, and another password per person.

WHAT EACH PERSON KEEPS

Stars, ratings, playlists and play counts belong to each user. Phone apps only get the shelves that user may see, and search, albums and artists are filtered the same way.

CLAUDE-VIPERMake Rachel's account yourself before she opens it, with only her shelf ticked. Then her first look is already the right one.

WHAT'S IN THE DATA FOLDER

/srv/stream/navidrome holds the database: users, shelves, playlists, stars and play counts, plus a cache of covers. Back that up; the music itself lives on dock1a.

WHAT THE GATE SEES

nginx's $station map sends music. and mustang. to :4533, and comedy. and sessions. to Audiobookshelf on :13378, all on 10.6.9.20. One server block for all of them.

THE FIRST-VISITOR CROWN

THE READ-ONLY SURPRISE

Navidrome can't fix a wrong tag or delete a duplicate: its library is mounted read-only.Fix files on the-box over the share (Picard); Navidrome picks the change up on its next scan.

THE STAND-UP SHUFFLE

A comedy album dropped into music/ turns up in the Commander's shuffle.Stand-up goes in dock1a/comedy, podcasts in dock1a/sessions: Audiobookshelf's shelves.

THE WATCHER LIMIT

Navidrome, Jellyfin, Kavita and ABS all watch the library, and Linux's default limit on file watchers is low.Part 3.3 raises it in /etc/sysctl.d/90-inotify.conf. Keep that file.

THE WIDE-OPEN WHITELIST

The trusted-header setting is the master key. Widen ND_REVERSEPROXYWHITELIST to the whole LAN and any device at home could claim to be any user.Keep it at exactly 10.6.9.10/32, the gate and nothing else.

AUDIOBOOK­SHELF

The Library: audiobooks and e-books at books.songofeo.com

Audiobookshelf (ABS to its friends) is the Library floor. It turns folders of audiobook files into a proper bookshelf with covers, chapters, series and narrators, and remembers exactly where every listener stopped, down to the second, across every device.

It also shelves e-books in a second library, with a reader in the browser. Audiobooks are where it shines: nothing else self-hosted comes close for audio, and its phone app can download books for offline listening on a long drive.

ABS lives in the stream pod on port 13378. Its own settings and its database sit in /srv/stream/abs/config, and the covers and caches it makes in /srv/stream/abs/metadata, both on the SGIN's SSD. The books come in read-only from dock1a.

CLAUDE-VIPERStart a book on the S21 on the drive home, keep going on the-box at your desk. ABS hands over your place in the story like a relay baton.
